title_candidates: Anthropic says Fable's hidden AI-research guardrails will become visible
summary: After backlash over invisible Claude Fable 5 restrictions for frontier AI research, Anthropic says it will make those safeguards visible to users.

primary_source.title: Anthropic Walks Back Policy That Could Have 'Sabotaged' AI Researchers Using Claude
primary_source.author: WIRED
key_facts: Anthropic told WIRED it is changing Fable 5 safeguards for frontier LLM development to make them visible.
The backlash centered on safeguards that could reduce help without clearly informing users.
The change keeps safeguards but moves them toward visible disclosure.
